headings: NuScale Power Modules and Nuclear Steam Supply System ("NSSS") Equipment
Nuclear Safety Regulatory Approval in the United States
paragraphs: Unless the context otherwise requires, all references in this section to "NuScale," the "Company," "we," "us" or "our" refer to the consolidated operations of NuScale Corp and NuScale LLC.

NuScale is redefining nuclear power through the development of proprietary and innovative SMR technology that the Company believes will deliver safe, scalable, cost-effective and reliable carbon-free power. The Company's core technology, the Light Water Nuclear Reactor NuScale Power Module™ ("NPM"), can generate 77 MWe and is premised on well-established nuclear technology principles, with a focus on the integration of components, simplification or elimination of systems and use of passive safety features. The Company believes this results in a safe and highly reliable power plant suitable to be sited close to where electricity, water desalinization, hydrogen production or process heat is needed.

Since 2007, over $1.8 billion has been invested in the development of NuScale technology, including more than $578.3 million from DOE under a series of cost-share programs, and we have received 513 patents globally, with an additional 268 patent applications currently pending. In September 2020, the Company's 12-module design (currently approved for 160 million watts of thermal power or 50 MWe per NPM) became the first and only SMR to receive an SDA from the Nuclear Regulatory Commission ("NRC"). In the U.S., the NRC oversees the licensing, permitting, and decommissioning of nuclear sites. In May 2025, the NRC finalized their review and approved the Company's second SDA application and the associated licensing topical reports for NuScale's 6-unit 77 MWe NPM design. Customers in the United States are now able to reference the approved design and SDA for expedited construction and operating licensing for a plant that is using the NuScale SMR technology.
NuScale's unique SMR has several key defining characteristics, including:
•Proven. The Company's NPM technology leverages existing light water nuclear reactor technology and conventional low-enriched uranium fuel supply that have been operating globally for over 60 years.

•Simple. NuScale's simple NPM design, based on natural circulation, integrates the reactor core, steam generators and pressurizer in a single factory-built vessel and eliminates the need for reactor coolant circulating pumps, large bore piping and other components found in conventional large-scale nuclear reactors. This simplicity improves safety and reduces capital and operational costs.

•Scalable. The NPMs allow for scalability from one to twelve modules in a single installation, with typical scales of 12-module (924 MWe), six-module (462 MWe) and four-module (308 MWe) versions. These NuScale SMR-based configurations can commence operation with one module and scale to house up to their approved capacity of four, six or twelve modules. This scalability is expected to allow customers to right-size their up-front capital investment and economically increase installed capacity over time through the addition of NPMs.

•Safe. NuScale believes that its SMR technology design is the safest in the world for nuclear plants and that it has several industry-first advantages over conventional large-scale nuclear plants, including an unlimited "coping" period during which the NPMs can be shut down and kept in a safe condition without operator intervention, AC or DC power or any additional cooling water. As a result, the Company believes it has numerous operational and commercial advantages including a safety case that supports a small, site-boundary emergency planning zone ("EPZ") designation by the NRC, as well as various resiliency and reliability features including the ability to start and operate a plant without AC or DC power to provide first-responder power.

In addition to the sale of NPMs, we will offer a diversified suite of services throughout the development and operating life of the power plant. The Company's suite of services is planned to include licensing support, testing, training, fuel supply services and program management, among others. We anticipate that the Company's service offerings will have high penetration rates across the customer base and will provide consistent, recurring revenues throughout the project deployment phase and operating lives of NPMs. We expect service revenue to begin approximately five years prior to a power plant's commercial operation date and to extend throughout the life of the power plant.
Potential offtake customers are a mix of domestic and international governments, utilities, state-owned enterprises and technology and industrial companies in need of carbon-free, reliable energy.

As discussed in the section titled "Supply Chain and Partners", we benefit from a global network of supply chain partners that we expect will play an integral role in bringing NuScale's technology to market around the world, including
engineering, procurement, design and constructions companies, and nuclear power industry experts, among other industries.

As discussed in the section titled "Customers and Prospective Customers" below, the Company has been working with one customer and one prospective customer. The customer is RoPower Nuclear S.A. ("RoPower"), which is a joint venture established by S.N. Nuclearelectrica S.A. ("Nuclearelectrica") and Nova Power & Gas S.A. During the first phases of the project, we defined their site and specific inputs for a power plant utilizing NuScale's 6-unit 77 MWe NPM design to be deployed at the Doicesti Power Station site in Romania.

The prospective customer, ENTRA1, is NuScale's exclusive global strategic partner for commercialization and development of power plants utilizing NPMs. Through this strategic relationship, the Company expects to collaborate on joint development initiatives with ENTRA1. ENTRA1 is currently in negotiations with Tennessee Valley Authority ("TVA") to deploy up to six 12-module power plants that would house the NPM design, and would be a landmark agreement in their seven-state region.

headings: Risks Related to Our Structure and Tax Matters
Payments under the Tax Receivable Agreement may exceed the actual tax benefits NuScale Corp realizes.
Risks Related to NuScale's Business and Industry
We have not yet entered into a binding contract with a customer to deliver NPMs, and there is no guarantee that we will be able to do so.
We face competition from other nuclear reactor technologies and from companies in China and Russia that currently operate commercial SMRs.
Any issues or delays in the development and manufacture of NPMs and related technology may adversely impact our business and financial condition.
We have incurred significant losses since inception, we expect to incur losses in the future, and we may not be able to achieve or maintain profitability.

The cost of electricity generated from nuclear sources or our NPMs may not be cost competitive with future electricity generation sources in some markets, which could materially and adversely affect our business.
Loss of government incentives to use nuclear power may have an adverse impact on the market for SMRs.
The market for SMRs generating nuclear power is not yet established and may not achieve the growth potential we expect or may grow more slowly than expected.
The PMA with ENTRA1 may result in significant cash outlays in the near term without guaranteeing revenue generating activities.
We may be unable to manage our future growth effectively, which could make it difficult to execute our business strategy.
We and our customers operate in a politically sensitive environment, and the public perception of nuclear energy can affect our customers and us.
Changes in U.S. trade policy, including the imposition of tariffs and the resulting consequences, may have a material adverse impact on our business and results of operations.
We expect we will require additional future funding to fund operations and commercialization, and such financing may not be available on acceptable terms.
Risks Related to NuScale's Intellectual Property
Our ability to protect our patents and other proprietary rights may be challenged and is not guaranteed, exposing us to the possible loss of competitive advantage.
We enjoy only limited geographical protection with respect to certain patents and may not be able to protect our intellectual property rights throughout the world.

We may not identify relevant third-party patents or may incorrectly interpret the relevance, scope or expiration of a third-party patent, which might adversely affect our ability to develop and market NPMs.
We may be subject to claims of ownership and other rights to our patents and other intellectual property by third parties.
Risks Related to NuScale's Regulatory Environment
Our customers must obtain additional regulatory approvals before they construct power plants using our NPMs, and approvals may be denied or delayed.
We and our customers could incur substantial costs as a result of violations of, or liabilities under, environmental laws.
paragraphs: We have identified the following risks and uncertainties that may have a material adverse effect on our business, financial condition, results of operations or reputation. The risks described below are not the only risks we face. Additional risks not presently known to us or that we currently believe are not material may also significantly affect our business, financial condition, results of operations or reputation. Our business could be harmed by any of these risks. In assessing these risks, you should also refer to the financial statements and related notes contained in this report.

NuScale Corp is a holding company and its only material asset is its interest in NuScale LLC, and it is accordingly dependent upon distributions made by its subsidiaries to pay taxes, make payments under the Tax Receivable Agreement and pay dividends and fees associated with being a public company such as director retainers, NYSE and other regulatory filings.

NuScale Corp is a holding company with no material assets other than its ownership of NuScale LLC units. As a result, NuScale Corp has no independent means of generating revenue or cash flow. NuScale Corp's ability to pay taxes, cause NuScale LLC to make payments under the Tax Receivable Agreement and pay dividends depends on the financial results and cash flows of NuScale LLC and the distributions it receives (directly or indirectly) from NuScale LLC. Deterioration in the financial condition, earnings or cash flow of NuScale LLC for any reason could limit or impair its ability to pay such distributions. Additionally, to the extent that NuScale Corp needs funds and NuScale LLC is restricted from making such distributions under applicable law or regulation, in order to satisfy certain obligations, under the terms of any financing arrangements, or is otherwise unable to provide such funds, it could materially adversely affect NuScale Corp's liquidity and financial condition.

NuScale LLC is treated as a partnership for United States federal income tax purposes and, as such, generally will not be subject to any entity-level United States federal income tax. Instead, taxable income will be allocated to holders of NuScale LLC units. Accordingly, NuScale Corp will be required to pay income taxes on its allocable share of any net taxable income from NuScale LLC. Under the terms of the Sixth Amended and Restated Limited Liability Company Agreement of NuScale LLC (the "A&R NuScale LLC Agreement"), NuScale LLC is obligated to make tax distributions to holders of NuScale LLC units calculated at certain assumed tax rates. In addition to income taxes, NuScale Corp is also expected to incur expenses related to its operations, including payment obligations under the Tax Receivable Agreement, which could be significant, and some of which will be reimbursed by NuScale LLC (excluding payment obligations under the Tax Receivable Agreement). NuScale Corp intends to cause NuScale LLC to make ordinary distributions and tax distributions to holders of NuScale LLC units on a pro rata basis in amounts sufficient to cover all applicable taxes, relevant operating expenses, payments under the Tax Receivable Agreement and dividends, if any, declared by NuScale Corp. However, as discussed above, NuScale LLC's ability to make such distributions may be subject to various limitations and restrictions. To the extent that NuScale Corp is unable to make payments under the Tax Receivable Agreement for any reason, such payments will be deferred and will accrue interest until paid; provided, however, that nonpayment for a specified period may constitute a breach of a material obligation under the Tax Receivable Agreement and therefore accelerate payments under the Tax Receivable Agreement, which could be substantial.

Additionally, although NuScale LLC generally will not be subject to any entity-level United States federal income tax, it may be liable under recent United States federal tax legislation for adjustments to prior year tax returns, absent an election to the contrary. In the event NuScale LLC's calculations of taxable income are incorrect, NuScale LLC and its members, including NuScale Corp, in later years may be subject to material liabilities pursuant to this legislation and its related guidance.

If NuScale LLC were treated as a corporation for United States federal income tax or state tax purposes, then the amount available for distribution by NuScale LLC could be substantially reduced and the value of NuScale Corp shares could be adversely affected.

paragraphs: The following discussion and analysis of the financial condition and results of operations should be read together with our financial statements as of and for the years ended December 31, 2025, 2024 and 2023 together with related notes thereto. This discussion may contain forward-looking statements based upon current expectations that involve risks and uncertainties, including, but not limited to, those described under the section entitled "Risk Factors" included in this Form 10-K. Our actual results may differ materially from those projected in these forward-looking statements as a result of various factors. As used herein, "NuScale," the "Company," "us," "our" or "we" refer to NuScale Corp, together with its consolidated subsidiaries.

Our mission is to provide scalable advanced nuclear technology to produce electricity, heat and clean water to improve the quality of life for people around the world. We are commercializing a modular, scalable electric Light Water Reactor nuclear power plant, that we believe will deliver safer scalable, cost-effective and reliable carbon free power. Our core technology, the NPM, can generate 77 MWe, with a focus on the integration of components, simplification or elimination of systems and use of passive safety features. We believe that this results in a safe and highly reliable power plant suitable to be sited close to where electricity, water desalinization, hydrogen production or process heat is needed.

Since our founding in 2007, we have made significant progress towards commercializing the first SMR in the United States. In September 2020, our 12-module design (currently approved for 160 million watts of thermal power

or 50 MWe per NPM) became the first and only SMR to receive an SDA from the NRC. In May 2025, the NRC finalized their review and approved our second SDA application and the associated licensing topical reports for our 6-unit 77 MWe NPM design, giving customers in the United States the ability to reference the approved design and SDA for expedited construction and operating licensing for a plant that is using the NuScale SMR technology.

NuScale has contracted with ENTRA1 as our global strategic partner for commercialization and development of power plants utilizing NPMs. ENTRA1 holds the exclusive rights for the worldwide commercialization, distribution, sales and development of our products, services and power plants. In this strategic partnership, the Company collaborates on joint development initiatives and financially contributes alongside the partnership in joint activities which may be recoverable as part of its development costs. ENTRA1 can decide whether to participate in a commercial opportunity. If ENTRA1 declines to participate in a commercial opportunity, NuScale may pursue the opportunity on its own.

Demand for energy in foreign markets is currently being driven by population growth, industrialization and urbanization with countries in Asia contributing the most to international growth. Rising living standards, driven by economic growth, has increased the need for residential electricity, a trend that is expected to increase in the coming years, with Asia forecasted to account for nearly 60% of global growth in electricity consumption through 2050.

The Company has currently one international customer: RoPower Nuclear S.A. ("RoPower"), which is a joint venture established by S.N. Nuclearelectrica S.A. ("Nuclearelectrica") and Nova Power & Gas S.A. In July 2024, NuScale and RoPower signed a technology licensing agreement, which granted RoPower a right to use certain intellectual property of NuScale's. In the third quarter of the 2024 fiscal year, Nuclearelectrica and RoPower signed the Front-End Engineering and Design ("FEED") Phase 2 contract with Fluor, a related party to NuScale. FEED Phase 2 included tasks related to the development of a Class 3 plant cost estimate, as well as support to RoPower with its regulatory and stakeholder engagements. NuScale completed their scope of FEED Phase 2 as a subcontractor to Fluor. On February 12, 2026 the Romanian Government approved the investment decision for the Doicesti SMR plant project, allowing for the ability to seek secured financing to further feasibility studies, and site-specific design work prior to any construction moving forward. This is a positive step in support of the project to the next phase. During the coming months, RoPower is authorized to advance the licensing and geotechnical work, finalize a pre-engineering, procurement and construction ("EPC") contract, and begin negotiating contracts for long lead items. We anticipate that the pre-EPC activities will have an estimated duration of up to 15 months and will include, among other things, the development of a Class 2 cost estimate for the project. NuScale has yet to commence, but looks forward to negotiating definitive agreements related to our scopes
within the elements of project finalization, construction, equipment installation and testing, plant commissioning, and post commercial operation date on-going technical support.

With ENTRA1 we continue to develop our international customer interest as we foresee a significant customer demand over the long-term to be outside of the United States as industry trends like decarbonization, an increasing demand for renewable energy alternatives, and changes in broader economic and geopolitical conditions continue to grow. Our collective team puts significant effort into developing dialogue with foreign governments and corporations in order to educate and market our technology.

Demand for energy in the United States is currently being driven by the significant growth in the data center industry, particularly as artificial intelligence ("AI") deployment, cloud computing adoption, and digital transformation initiatives accelerate across sectors. Further, the United States government has identified nuclear technology as imperative to the country's national security objectives and ordered the expansion of American nuclear energy capacity to 400 gigawatts by 2050, or nearly 400% the current capacity.

On August 27, 2025, NuScale LLC and ENTRA1 executed a PMA. Under the PMA, NuScale is named the key supplier to future ENTRA1 Energy Projects (as defined in Note 9 in the accompanying consolidated financial statements) with respect to the supply of SMR technology. The PMA also includes a negotiated maximum sale price for each NPM to be delivered and installed in an ENTRA1 Energy Project, subject to adjustments. It is anticipated that NuScale will enter into agreements for the delivery and installation of NPMs with ENTRA1.

On September 2, 2025, the Tennessee Valley Authority ("TVA") announced the signing of a non-binding agreement under which ENTRA1 and TVA will collaborate to develop plants to provide TVA with up to 6 gigawatts of new nuclear power generation, with ENTRA1's immediate strategy being the utilization of NuScale's SMR equipment inside ENTRA1 Energy PlantsTM.

Under the PMA, we are focused on our expanded ENTRA1 partnership positioning their ENTRA1 Energy Plants™ with NuScale SMRs inside first to TVA. The PMA also positions us to serve hyperscaler, technology, industrial and micro-grid customers in sectors that include direct air capture, water desalinization, hydrogen production and mission critical facilities.

We believe that our performance and future success depend on a number of factors that present significant opportunities for us but also pose risks and challenges, including competition from carbon-based and other non-carbon-based energy generators, the risk of perceived safety issues and their consequences for our reputation and the other factors discussed under the section titled "Risk Factors." We believe the factors described below are key to our success.

paragraphs: 除非文意另有所指，本節所有提及「NuScale」、「本公司」、「我們」、「我們」或「我們」均指 NuScale Corp 與 NuScale LLC 合併後的營運。

NuScale 透過開發專屬且創新之小型模組反應爐（SMR）技術，重新定義核能發電。本公司認為此技術將提供安全、可擴充、成本效益佳且可靠的無碳電力。本公司核心技術為輕水核反應爐 NuScale Power Module™（"NPM"），可產生 77 MWe，其設計基於已建立的核能技術原則，著重於零組件整合、系統簡化或消除，以及使用被動安全功能。本公司認為此設計可提供安全且高度可靠之發電廠，適合設置於電力、海水淡化、氫氣生產或過程熱能所需之場所。

自 2007 年以來，已投入逾 1.8 十億美元用於 NuScale 技術之開發，包括來自美國能源部（DOE）透過一系列成本分擔計畫之逾 578.3 百萬美元，本公司已取得全球 513 份專利，另有 268 份專利申請正在審查中。2020 年 9 月，本公司 12 模組設計（目前核准為 160 百萬瓦熱功率或每 NPM 50 MWe）成為首個且唯一取得核能規管委員會（"NRC"）之 SDA 的 SMR。在美國，NRC 負責核能場地之許可、核准及除役管理。2025 年 5 月，NRC 完成審查並核准本公司第二個 SDA 申請及相關許可主題報告，針對 NuScale 6 單元 77 MWe NPM 設計。美國客戶現可參考核准設計及 SDA 以加速建設與營運許可程序，用於採用 NuScale SMR 技術之電廠。
NuScale 唯一之 SMR 具備以下關鍵特徵：
•已驗證。本公司 NPM 技術運用現有輕水核反應爐技術及傳統低濃度鈾燃料供應，已在全球運作逾 60 年。
•簡易。NuScale 簡易 NPM 設計基於自然循環，將反應堆核心、蒸汽發生器及壓力容器整合於單一工廠製造之容器內，並消除傳統大型核電廠中反應堆冷卻劑循環泵、大型管路及其他零組件之需求。此簡易性可提升安全性並降低資本與營運成本。
•可擴充。NPM 可從單一模組擴充至十二模組於同一設施，典型規模為 12 模組（924 MWe）、六模組（462 MWe）及四模組（308 MWe）版本。這些 NuScale SMR 之配置可從單一模組開始運作，並逐步擴充至最多核准容量之四、六或十二模組。此可擴充性預期可讓客戶適度調整初期資本投資，並透過增加 NPM 來經濟性提升裝設容量。

•安全。NuScale 相信其 SMR 技術設計為全球核電廠中最安全的，且相比傳統大型核電廠，具備多項產業首創優勢，包括在 NPM 停機後可無需操作人員、交流電或直流電、任何額外冷卻水即可維持安全狀態之無限 "coping" 期間。因此，本公司認為其具備多項運作與商業優勢，包括支持 NRC 針對小型、場界內之緊急應變區（"EPZ"）之指定之安全案例，以及各種韌性與可靠性功能，包括在無交流電或直流電時即可啟動並運作電廠以提供第一線應變單位電力。
除銷售NPMs外，本公司將於電力廠的開發及運營期間提供多樣化的服務組合。本公司服務組合預計將包括授權支援、測試、培訓、燃料供應服務及專案管理，等等。本公司預期其服務產品將在客戶羣中具有高比例的滲透率，並在專案部署階段及NPMs的運營期間提供穩定且持續的收入。本公司預期服務收入將在電力廠商業運作日期前約五年開始，並延續至電力廠的整個生命週期。
潛在的買方為國內與國際政府、電力公司、國有企業及需要無碳、可靠能源的科技與工業公司所組成的混合體。
如「供應鏈與夥伴」節所述，本公司受益於全球供應鏈夥伴網路，預期這些夥伴將在全球範圍內協助NuScale的技術推向市場，包括
工程、採購、設計與建設公司，以及核能產業專家，以及其他產業。

如下文「客戶與潛在客戶」節所述，本公司已與一家客戶及一家潛在客戶合作。該客戶為RoPower Nuclear S.A.（「RoPower」），為S.N. Nuclearelectrica S.A.（「Nuclearelectrica」）與Nova Power & Gas S.A.共同成立的合資公司。在專案的初期階段，我們已定義其場地及電力廠使用NuScale的6單元77 MWe NPM設計，並部署於羅馬尼亞Doicesti電力廠場地的特定輸入。
潛在客戶ENTRA1為NuScale在利用NPMs的電力廠商業化與開發方面的獨家全球戰略夥伴。透過此戰略合作關係，本公司預期將與ENTRA1合作進行共同開發計畫。ENTRA1目前正與田納西河谷管理局（「TVA」）進行談判，以部署最多六座12模組的電力廠，這些電力廠將採用NPM設計，這將是其七州地區的重要協議。

paragraphs: 以下對財務狀況及營運結果的討論與分析應與我們截至2025年12月31日、2024年12月31日及2023年12月31日的財務報表及其相關附註一併閱讀。此討論可能包含基於目前預期的展望性陳述，涉及風險與不確定性，包括但不限於本Form 10-K中「風險因素」部分所描述的風險。我們的實際結果可能與這些展望性陳述中預測的結果有重大差異，原因在於多種因素。如本文所用，"NuScale"、"本公司"、"本公司"、"我們"或"我們"均指NuScale Corp，包括其合併子公司。

我們的使命是提供可擴展的先進核能技術，用以產生電力、熱能及潔淨水，以改善全球人們的生活品質。我們正在商業化一種模組化、可擴展的電力輕水反應器核能發電廠，我們相信這將提供更安全、可擴展、成本效益佳且可靠的無碳電力。我們的核心技術，即NPM，可產生77 MWe，並著重於零組件整合、系統簡化或消除，以及使用被動安全功能。我們相信這會使發電廠更安全且高度可靠，適合設置在需要電力、海水淡化、氫氣生產或過程熱能的地方。
自2007年成立以來，我們已取得商業化美國首座SMR的重大進展。2020年9月，我們的12模組設計（目前核准為160 百萬瓦的熱功率
或每NPM 50 MWe）成為美國首座且唯一取得NRC SDA的SMR。2025年5月，NRC完成審查並核准我們的第二個SDA申請及相關許可主題報告，針對我們的6單位77 MWe NPM設計，使美國客戶能參考核准的設計與SDA，以加速建設與營運許可的程序。
NuScale已與ENTRA1簽訂合作契約，作為我們商業化與開發使用NPM發電廠的全球戰略夥伴。ENTRA1擁有全球商業化、分銷、銷售與開發我們產品、服務與發電廠的獨家權利。在這項戰略合作關係中，本公司參與共同開發計畫，並在共同活動中提供財務支援，這些支援可能作為開發成本的一部分予以回收。ENTRA1可決定是否參與商業機會。若ENTRA1拒絕參與某項商業機會，NuScale可能自行追求該機會。
目前外國市場對能源的需求主要由人口成長、工業化與都市化所驅動，亞洲國家對國際成長的貢獻最大。隨著經濟成長所帶來的生活水準提高，住宅用電需求增加，這種趨勢預期在未來幾年會持續增加，預計到2050年，亞洲將佔全球電力消費成長的近60%。

本公司目前有一個國際客戶：RoPower Nuclear S.A.（"RoPower"），為S.N. Nuclearelectrica S.A.（"Nuclearelectrica"）與Nova Power & Gas S.A.共同成立的合資公司。2024年7月，NuScale與RoPower簽訂技術授權協議，授予RoPower使用NuScale智慧財產權的權利。在2024會計年度的第三季，Nuclearelectrica與RoPower與Fluor簽訂Front-End Engineering and Design（"FEED"）第二階段契約，Fluor為NuScale的關聯公司。FEED第二階段包含開發Class 3發電廠成本估算的任務，以及協助RoPower進行法規與利害關係人溝通的支援。NuScale作為Fluor的分包商完成FEED第二階段的範疇。2026年2月12日，羅馬尼亞政府核准Doicesti SMR發電廠專案的投資決策，允許尋求取得secured financing以進一步進行可行性研究及特定場地設計工作，於任何建設工作開始前。這是專案邁向下一階段的積極進展。未來幾個月，RoPower被授權推進許可與地質工程工作，完成預工程、採購與建設（"EPC"）契約，並開始談判長週期採購項目契約。我們預期預-EPC活動的估計持續時間為最多15個月，並包含開發專案Class 2成本估算等事項。NuScale尚未開始，但期待與我們的範疇進行談判確定契約，
包含專案最終化、建設、設備安裝與測試、發電廠啟動、以及商業運作後的技術支援。
With ENTRA1 我們持續發展國際客戶興趣，因為我們預期在長遠來看，客戶需求將主要來自美國境外，因產業趨勢如減碳、對可再生能源替代方案需求增加，以及總體經濟與地緣政治條件的變化持續成長。我們的團隊 collectively 花費大量努力與外國政府及企業進行對話，以教育並行銷我們的技術。
美國目前的能源需求主要由資料中心產業的顯著成長所驅動，特別是人工智慧（"AI"）部署、雲端計算採用及數位轉型計畫在各產業加速推進。此外，美國政府已將核能技術視為國家安全目標的重要組成部分，並下令將美國核能發電容量擴充至 400 億瓦特，於 2050 年前，或為目前容量的近 400%。

2025 年 8 月 27 日，NuScale LLC 與 ENTRA1 簽署了一項 PMA。根據 PMA，NuScale 被指定為未來 ENTRA1 Energy Projects（如附註 9 所述的合併財務報表中所定義）的關鍵供應商，有關 SMR 技術的供應。PMA 還包含針對每個 NPM 交付並安裝於 ENTRA1 Energy Project 的協議最高售價，並可依調整。預期 NuScale 將與 ENTRA1 簽署有關 NPM 交付與安裝的協議。
2025 年 9 月 2 日，田納西河谷管理局（"TVA"）宣佈簽署了一項非綁定協議，根據該協議，ENTRA1 與 TVA 將合作開發電廠，以提供 TVA 最多 6 億瓦特的新核能發電，ENTRA1 的即時策略為在 ENTRA1 Energy PlantsTM 中利用 NuScale 的 SMR 裝置。
根據 PMA，我們專注於擴展 ENTRA1 合作夥伴關係，將其 ENTRA1 Energy Plants™ 與 NuScale SMRs 作為首選提供給 TVA。PMA 也使我們能服務超級雲端、科技、工業及微電網客戶，這些客戶涉及直接空氣捕獲、海水淡化、氫氣生產及關鍵設施等領域。
我們認為，我們的表現與未來成功取決於多種因素，這些因素為我們帶來顯著的機會，但也帶來風險與挑戰，包括來自碳基及其他非碳基能源發電商的競爭、被認為安全問題的風險及其對我們聲譽的影響，以及其他在 "風險因素" 章節中討論的因素。我們認為，以下所述的因素對我們的成功至關重要。

headings: 與本公司結構及稅務事項相關之風險
根據稅收應收款協議所支付之金額，可能高於 NuScale Corp 實際實現之稅務好處。
與 NuScale 事業及產業相關之風險
本公司尚未與客戶簽訂具約束力之合約以交付 NPMs，且無法保證本公司將能實現此目標。
本公司面臨來自其他核能反應堆技術及中國與俄羅斯目前運作商業 SMRs 之公司之競爭。
任何有關 NPMs 及相關技術之開發與製造問題或延誤，可能對本公司之業務與財務狀況造成不利影響。
本公司自設立以來已產生重大虧損，預期未來仍將產生虧損，且可能無法實現或維持盈利。
來自核能來源或本公司 NPMs 產生之電力成本，可能在某些市場中無法與未來電力來源之成本競爭，這可能會對本公司業務造成重大且不利之影響。
政府對使用核能的補貼減少，可能對小型模組反應堆（SMRs）市場產生不利影響。
產生核能的小型模組反應堆（SMRs）市場尚未建立，可能無法達到我們預期的成長潛力，或成長速度可能慢於預期。
與 ENTRA1 經過認證的 PMA 可能導致近期產生重大現金支出，但不保證能產生收入活動。
我們可能無法有效管理未來的成長，這可能使執行我們的業務策略變得困難。
我們與客戶所處的環境具有政治敏感性，而公眾對核能的觀感可能影響我們的客戶與我們。
美國貿易政策的變動，包括課徵關稅及其後果，可能對我們的業務與營運成果產生重大不利影響。
我們預期將需要額外的未來資金以支應營運與商業化，而這樣的融資可能無法在可接受的條件下取得。
與 NuScale 智慧財產權相關的風險
本公司保護專利及其他專有權利的能力可能受到質疑且無法保證，使本公司面臨喪失競爭優勢的風險。
本公司對於某些專利僅享有有限的地理範圍保護，可能無法在全球範圍內保護智慧財產權。
本公司可能無法識別相關的第三方專利，或可能錯誤地解釋第三方專利的相關性、範圍或到期日，這可能會不利於本公司開發與行銷 NPMs 的能力。
本公司可能面臨第三方聲稱擁有本公司專利及其他智慧財產權的所有權或其他權利的主張。
與 NuScale 訴訟環境相關的風險
本公司客戶在使用本公司 NPMs 建造核電廠前必須取得額外的法規核准，且核准可能被拒絕或延宕。
本公司與本公司客戶可能因違反法規或因法規責任而產生重大成本。
paragraphs: 我們已識別出下列風險與不確定性，這些風險與不確定性可能對我們的業務、財務狀況、營運成果或聲譽造成重大不利影響。下列所述的風險並非我們所面臨的唯一風險。此外，尚有其他風險，目前我們尚未知悉，或目前認為不具重大性，也可能對我們的業務、財務狀況、營運成果或聲譽造成重大影響。我們的業務可能因任何這些風險而受到損害。在評估這些風險時，您應同時參考本報告中所包含的財務報表及其相關附註。
NuScale Corp 是一家控股公司，其唯一的重大資產為其對 NuScale LLC 的權益，因此依賴其子公司所發放的分紅以支付稅款、履行稅收應收協議下的付款及支付股息與作為上市公司相關的費用，例如董事薪酬、紐約證券交易所（NYSE）及其他監管 filings。

NuScale Corp 是一家無重大資產的控股公司，其資產僅為對 NuScale LLC 單元的所有權。因此，NuScale Corp 沒有獨立產生收入或現金流的能力。NuScale Corp 有能力支付稅款、促使 NuScale LLC 履行稅收應收協議下的付款及支付股息，取決於 NuScale LLC 的財務表現與現金流，以及其從 NuScale LLC 收到（直接或間接）的分紅。若因任何原因 NuScale LLC 的財務狀況、獲利或現金流惡化，可能會限制或影響其支付這些分紅的能力。此外，若 NuScale Corp 需要資金，而 NuScale LLC 因適用法律或監管規定而無法進行這些分紅，或因任何融資安排的條款而受到限制，或因其他原因無法提供資金，可能會對 NuScale Corp 的流動性與財務狀況造成重大不利影響。

NuScale LLC 在美國聯邦所得稅用途上被視為合夥企業，因此通常不會受到任何企業層級的美國聯邦所得稅影響。相反地，應課稅所得將分配給 NuScale LLC 單元持有人。因此，NuScale Corp 將需就其應分配的任何淨課稅所得支付所得稅。根據 NuScale LLC 的第六次修正並重述有限責任公司協議（"A&R NuScale LLC 協議"），NuScale LLC 有義務根據某些假設稅率計算並向 NuScale LLC 單元持有人支付稅收分紅。除了所得稅外，NuScale Corp 也預期會產生與其營運相關的費用，包括稅收應收協議下的付款義務，這些費用可能相當重大，其中部分費用將由 NuScale LLC 予以補償（不包括稅收應收協議下的付款義務）。NuScale Corp 計畫促使 NuScale LLC 依照比例，以足夠的金額進行普通分紅與稅收分紅，以涵蓋所有相關稅款、營運費用、稅收應收協議下的付款及 NuScale Corp 聲明的股息（如有）。然而，如上所述，NuScale LLC 進行這些分紅的能力可能受到各種限制與條件的影響。若因任何原因 NuScale Corp 無法履行稅收應收協議下的付款，這些付款將被延後，並累計利息直至支付為止；但若在指定期間內未付款，可能構成違反稅收應收協議中的重大義務，因此可能加速稅收應收協議下的付款，這些付款可能相當重大。
此外，雖然 NuScale LLC 通常不會受到任何企業層級的美國聯邦所得稅影響，但根據最近的美國聯邦稅法立法，其可能因調整前年度稅務申報而負有責任，除非作出相反選擇。若 NuScale LLC 對應課稅所得的計算有誤，NuScale LLC 及其成員（包括 NuScale Corp）在後續年度可能根據此立法及其相關指引而面臨重大責任。
若 NuScale LLC 被視為美國聯邦所得稅或州稅用途上的公司，則 NuScale LLC 可供分配的金額可能大幅減少，而 NuScale Corp 股票的價值也可能受到不利影響。
